purpose: Predeclare the exact paired PDD + lateral-profile validation route for the fixed current production 40x40 photon source surrogates. This validates multi-observable predictive adequacy of the factorized source surrogate; it does NOT claim unique recovery of the clinical phase-space spectrum.

external_acceptance_reference.role: Provides 2%/2 mm tolerance guidance for relative water-phantom dose distributions across clinical field sizes. This protocol uses region-based dose/DTA criteria rather than a gamma pass-rate as the primary profile gate.

replacement_source_freeze_v3_3.role: Pre-digitization forensic freeze establishing bilateral figure-format eligibility of the replacement 10-MV and 15-MV holdout sources.

non_negotiable_rules: No current production spectrum may be changed.
No source endpoint, energy bin, probability mass, smoothing, interpolation or normalization rule may be changed.
No acceptance threshold may be changed after a holdout curve is digitized.
No curve may be digitized while viewing a project-source prediction.
No digitized holdout may be smoothed to improve agreement.
No left/right symmetrization of measured profiles is allowed.
No post-hoc horizontal shift is allowed except the preregistered detector-axis centering rule below.
If either observable in a beam pair fails, Route C fails for that beam.
A Route-C pass validates the fixed factorized surrogate for the paired measured observables; it does not relabel the 1-D spectrum as a uniquely measured clinical spectrum.
Existing Landauer/Pacyniak/Sawkey PDD results remain diagnostic-only and are not promoted.
Existing Ali/Waggener/Aspradakis spectra remain already-seen corroborative evidence and cannot be tuning targets.

ben_hdech_scaling.pdd_rule: Digitize the 40x40 experimental black curve. Undo the published k=0.4 vertical display factor before final PDD normalization. Normalize PDD to its digitized dmax=100% exactly once.
ben_hdech_scaling.profile_rule: Digitize the 40x40 experimental black profile. The k=0.4 display factor is multiplicative and cancels under the preregistered CAX profile normalization. Normalize the profile to its own CAX=100% for shape evaluation; do not use this normalization for PDD.

digitization_contract.profile_centering_rule: Use the published x=0 coordinate as CAX. No fitted lateral translation is allowed. If a digitizer calibration produces a sub-pixel zero offset, only the axis-calibration transform may correct it; the reference curve itself may not be shifted to improve agreement.

pdd_acceptance.evaluation_region: at and beyond the digitized reference dmax
pdd_acceptance.normalization: reference and MC each normalized to their own dmax=100%
pdd_acceptance.pass_rule: all three numeric thresholds must pass

profile_acceptance.normalization: reference and MC each normalized to CAX=100% at the frozen profile depth
profile_acceptance.plateau_definition: reference points inside |x| <= 16 cm with reference dose >=80% of CAX for a nominal 40x40 cm2 field
profile_acceptance.edge_rule: For each 20%, 50%, and 80% level, independently interpolate the left and right crossing in reference and MC curves. All six absolute crossing distance differences must be <=2.0 mm.
profile_acceptance.secondary_diagnostic: A 1-D global 2%/2 mm gamma curve may be reported for context, but gamma pass rate is not a primary acceptance condition.
profile_acceptance.pass_rule: plateau p90 threshold passes AND all six 20/50/80% edge DTA thresholds pass

beam_pass_requires: reference independence from project source construction/fitting
complete digitization provenance and SHA-256 manifest
complete MC provenance and unchanged production-source semantic hash
not_claimed: unique recovery of the clinical phase-space spectrum
machine-specific spectrum identity for generic project-interpolated sources
paired_route_c_gate.notebook_mapping_if_passed: Map to an allowed Phase-I non-TVL pass level only with an explicit validation_claim_scope field preserving the limited claim above. Do not map a Route-C result to SPECTRAL_VALIDATED.

mc_execution_contract.reason: This is a prospectively frozen Step-2C validation campaign with unchanged sources, separate from the v12.16 source-construction audit that intentionally ran zero new PDD transport.
recommended_single_run_outputs: lateral profile at the frozen reference depth

failure_policy: If any beam fails, do not alter the source or thresholds under v1.
Report which observable failed and why.
A profile failure may identify a limitation of the factorized lateral source model rather than the energy spectrum; do not misattribute it.
Any revised source/phase-space model requires a new version, new preregistration and new independent holdout.

revision_v1_1.change_scope: Holdout-source reassignment only for 10MV and 15MV after the previously assigned profile figures were found incompatible with the already-frozen bilateral 20/50/80% edge-crossing gate.

profile_selection_policy.10MV: Use the Araki 2005 Figure 5(d) measured 40x40 cm2 profile at 10 cm depth. The 10-cm depth is frozen before digitization and preserves the prior 10-MV profile depth.
profile_selection_policy.15MV: Use the Tian et al. 2017 Figure 5 measured cross-line 40x40 cm2 profile at 10 cm depth as the single primary gating lateral profile. The inline 10-cm profile and 20-cm profiles are non-gating secondary evidence unless a future separately preregistered protocol states otherwise.
profile_selection_policy.15MV_shallow_profile: EXCLUDED. Figure 5 caption and Section 3.A.2 state 2.8 cm, while Table 4 lists 2.1 cm for the 40x40 field. No reconciliation is assumed.
